summary: Built the P2W page — every dev product and game pass now lists its real Robux cost, whether it's still obtainable, and its full reward list with icons (crystals, potions, Luck/Roll Speed/Walkspeed/Unbox Slot multipliers and bonuses, real item icons, and chat tags all render with their own icon instead of plain text). Also built out this very update-log system: both home-page panels now show a preview of recent updates with a "View All Updates" button once the list grows past that, and Game Updates is now populated with the actual game's real patch history (v1.0.1 through v3.0.0) sourced from the dev's own public patch-notes repo, each with its real release date. Later the same day: fixed a Brewer typo and hardened every wiki data file fetch to always load fresh instead of a stale cached copy; fixed a missing P2W icon and turned "Drillbit & Co." mentions into real links to the game's Roblox page; built the Enchanter page (mastery/speed mechanics, every rarity's real upgrade paths and variant multipliers, real per-rarity enchant times, and a "Your enchant speed" box that recalculates every time live and remembers what you typed); and built the Furnace Loot page (the "More Furnace Loot!" mastery's real drop-chance and active-drops-cap formulas, plus real loot odds sourced from testing) with a cleaner Corium Dropper icon and clearer section headings, also added to the Brewer and Rebirth pages.

Wiki content build-out: real page navigation across the home page (all 13 sections, each with its own background art), then full pages built for Rebirth, Codes, Conveyor, Decoration, and Brewer — every reward, code, conveyor piece, decoration, and potion upcraft now has real data and its own icon.
The Wiki tool itself was added and made the site's default landing page. Capgrader Generator results now show colored Base/Shiny variant badges with a twinkling sparkle effect on Shiny rows.

Capgrader Generator chains can now mix Base and Shiny copies of the same item within one chain (previously it only ever used the single "best" owned variant), plus dependency/ordering fixes. The MPA / Chopping Block tool was also added.
MPA / Chopping Block graduated out of WIP status, a real rotation bug affecting the Base Portable Upgrader was fixed, and 5 new capgraders were added to the database.
Bug fixes: the Calculator tool no longer bleeds into other tools, and stale Capgrader Generator results are properly cleared after editing your setup.
Added the Calculator tool — a scientific calculator that understands the game's own number abbreviations (K, M, B, T, and beyond).
Added the Luck / Crate Simulator tool, plus a shared help widget for Capgrader Generator and Luck Simulator.
Site bring-up: Capgrader Generator and the feedback widget (bug reports and suggestions, with image/video attachments) went live.
